data.name: Iron Weapon
data.description: You can create a melee simple or martial weapon that lasts for %1 minutes.  This weapon is appropriate for your size and entirely made of metal (even if it would normally include non-metal parts, such as a spear's shaft) but functions as if it were a normal weapon of its type. You are considered proficient with this weapon. The weapon disappears after 1 round if it leaves your grasp. You can use this ability %2/day.|IronWeaponDuration|IronWeaponTimes|!PRECLASS:1,Oracle=3
